question: A cone-shaped nozzle has a volume of 231 cm3 and a base radius of 3.5 cm. Find its slant height.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ First, find the **height (h)**: h = (3 × Volume) ÷ (π × r²) = (3 × 231) ÷ (22/7 × 3.5 × 3.5) = 18 cm. Now, use the **Pythagoras Theorem** to find **slant height (l)**: l = √(h² + r²). l = √(18² + 3.5²) = √(324 + 12.25) = √336.25 ≈ 18.3 cm. **∴ The correct answer is 18.3 cm.**
